findings.message: The fast-toss capture has launch speed 10 and gravity 1, so the scrubber should read -10 to 10 s. The layout text says Launch speed 10 reads -1.020408 to 1.020408 s, which is the range for gravity 9.8. The trace shows [-10,10], which fits these inputs. The layout text and the trace don't agree, so the scrubber range can't be confirmed from what was shown.

The acceleration arrow for the tossed ball runs from y=243 to y=365.5 at the default inputs. That is below the launch level, and it extends well past the lane box, which ends at y=279. The arrow's length is the same at every state, but its scale is not shown. It is probably clipped or off-frame. The velocity and acceleration arrows also use different scales, which the scene says should be shared. This can't be fully judged without pixels.

With gravity 1, the callout reads 'a = −1.0 m/s²', which is fine. The acceleration arrow is only 12.5 px long, against 122.5 px at g=9.8. The arrow is therefore proportional to g, which is consistent.

The height axis runs from 0 to 52.5 m, so at the default apex of 1.28 m the ball moves only about 4 px. The ball and the gate ball are barely distinguishable between captures. Before the release, the gate ball's drawn position also differs from the launch level.
